data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'barakah' meaning blessing or favor. In Islamic tradition, Barikaa represents the blessings of God and the hope for a life filled with His blessings. The name Barikaa carries the meaning “Blessing, Favor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Barikaa usually hope their child will grow to embody blessing, favor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
